citations.assessment: In the parable about the king’s son, the checked Devarim Rabbah names R. Shmuel Pargʿrita speaking in R. Meir’s name. Preserve the heading’s differing consonants.
The commentary says the Arukh appears to treat the name as a place-name. The attribution to the Arukh belongs to the commentary.

notes.text: The checked Devarim Rabbah spells the name פרגריטא. Heilprin prints פדגריטא.
Mattenot Kehunah gives the place-name explanation as its reading of the Arukh.
